summary.intent: Review and resolve 4 open PR threads, then fix a merge logic bug in IPNS record resolution where equal-sequence network results could drop cached signature fields.
summary.outcome: All 4 PR threads replied to and resolved. The equal-sequence cache-enrichment bug was fixed in ipns.service.ts and covered by 2 new tests; all 833 tests pass and changes were committed and pushed.

repo: IPNS service uses a two-source resolution strategy: delegated routing (network) and a DB cache (folderIpnsRepo). The merge logic at ~line 421-443 compares sequenceNumber and cid to decide which source wins.
Parsed signedRecord fields (signatureV2, data, pubKey) may be absent from network-resolved records but present in DB-cached records via parseCachedRecord/withCachedPublicKey.
JSDoc on ipns key size was incorrect (said 64-byte, should be 32-byte) in both web/ipns.service.ts:58 and sdk-core/ipns/index.ts:63; fixed in commit 91ccff2ed.

code.finding: The merge block only preferred DB result when dbSeq > networkSeq. Equal-sequence case returned raw network result, silently dropping signatureV2, data, and pubKey from the cached signedRecord. Fixed to enrich network result with cached signature fields when sequences and CID match.

Existing tests around this range cover the delegated routing resolution path. Added a new test for the equal-sequence cache-enrichment regression: network result has no signatureV2/data, DB cache has signedRecord with matching sequence, assert merged result carries cached signature fields.
signedRecord vs DTO mismatch — deferred to S1 (not yet fixed in this session).
Hardcoded sequence value '1' — deferred to S1 (not yet fixed in this session).

workflow: GitHub CLI auth can time out mid-session; gh auth login is the recovery path. Bash background tasks surfaced the failure via task-notification, allowing retry.
Running the full test suite before committing caught no regressions; 2 new tests were added for the new branch.

friction: GitHub auth timed out during PR thread resolution, causing the first batch of gh CLI calls to fail with exit code 1 and requiring a retry after re-authentication.
